milestone: M3 Reusable Workflow Definition and Execution Engine
source_of_scope: docs/ROADMAP.md, section 13: M3 Sequential Engineering Task Plan

status_meanings.pending: Not started or not established as implemented
status_meanings.in_progress: One approved bounded task is currently being worked on
status_meanings.blocked: Work cannot continue; document exact blocker

rules: Do not start implementation solely because a task is listed.
Before activating a task, reconcile local repository state with current source, Git and tests.
At most one task may have status in_progress at a time; active_task_id must identify that task or be null.
Do not bypass dependency order or expand an active task into later features.
Use RED -> GREEN -> regression verification for implementation tasks.
Only mark verified after acceptance criteria, actual commands, outcomes and revision are recorded.
Do not silently change roadmap scope or mark planned work implemented.
Do not commit, push, deploy, or alter production resources without authorization.

tasks.title: Workflow Definition Models
tasks.objective: Define reusable workflow, trigger, and step models without enrollment-specific fields.
acceptance_criteria: Models compile in Go.
Tests demonstrate two distinct workflow definitions without business-specific engine fields.

evidence.result: RED: focused tests exited 1 with undefined model types. GREEN: focused tests exited 0. Unified verifier initially exited 1 with four validator fixture failures; after fixture corrections, exited 1 at Go unit tests from sandbox cache denial; permission-enabled rerun exited 0: tracker, 44 Python tests, Go unit/race tests, go vet, and both whitespace checks PASS. Review confirms two distinct declarative workflows and no business-specific model fields. M3.2-M3.10 remain pending; no runner or validation implemented. Final verification after tracker/checkpoint updates passed tracker, 44 Python tests, Go unit and race tests, then exited 1 at go vet from sandbox cache denial; permission-enabled final rerun exited 0 with all six checks PASS.
evidence.reviewed_by: Codex: acceptance criteria and source/test evidence reviewed; no human acceptance claimed

tasks.title: Definition Validation
tasks.objective: Reject missing IDs, invalid start steps, unsupported step types, broken links, missing handler references, invalid branching, and unsupported graph cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Valid definitions are accepted.
Malformed definitions produce deterministic validation errors.

tasks.title: Trigger Matching
tasks.objective: Match incoming events to eligible workflow definitions without launching nonmatching workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Matching events activate eligible workflows.
Nonmatching events cause no execution side effects.

tasks.title: Handler Registration
tasks.objective: Register action handlers and condition predicates by name without tying engine core to business integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple implementations can be registered and invoked by name.
Unknown handlers are rejected.

tasks.title: Conditions and Branching
tasks.objective: Evaluate predicates and select configured true/false successor steps.
acceptance_criteria: Both branches are tested.
Condition errors are handled and tested.

tasks.title: Sequential Action Execution
tasks.objective: Execute configured actions in order and advance progress only after successful steps.
acceptance_criteria: Actions run in required order.
A failed action stops the normal path and returns an error outcome.

tasks.title: Wait and Resume
tasks.objective: Represent delays with resume deadlines and retain an in-memory execution cursor, without sleeping a worker for the entire wait.
acceptance_criteria: Early resume does not advance incorrectly.
Eligible resume continues from the correct step without replaying earlier completed actions in the tested in-memory scenario.
No durable restart guarantee is claimed.

tasks.title: M2 Lifecycle Integration
tasks.objective: Use repository TryClaim for ownership and Complete/Fail for terminal runner outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Success and failure preserve M2 status, version, and history invariants.
Failures use Fail with a nonempty reason; SaveIfVersion is not used to mark FAILED.

tasks.title: Concurrency and Failure Verification
tasks.objective: Test competing execution attempts, invalid ownership, action errors, and duplicate invocations.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate action execution in the tested single-process concurrent scenario.
Failure reasons and lifecycle state remain correct.
No distributed exactly-once guarantee is claimed.

tasks.title: Reusability and Milestone Acceptance
tasks.objective: Run two genuinely different workflows through the same engine and execute full regression verification.
acceptance_criteria: Both workflows run without modifying the engine core.
Existing M1/M2 tests and race checks pass.
Known limitations are documented.
